Frederick Douglass, Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/frederick-douglass/narrative-of-the-life-of-frederick-douglass

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Frederick Douglass, the author, died 1895 (Wikidata Q215562, P570 = 1895-02-20).
- William Lloyd Garrison, writer of the preface, died 1879 (Wikidata Q360155, P570 = 1879-05-24).
- Wendell Phillips, writer of the introduction letter, died 1884 (Wikidata Q530310, P570 = 1884-02-02).

First publication of the text used: 1845 (SE colophon: 'Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass was published in 1845 by Frederick Douglass.'; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Narrative_of_the_Life_of_Frederick_Douglass lists the United States as the country and Anti-Slavery Office as the publisher).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1845, before 1931. A work published in 1845 entered the United States public domain on 1 January 1941. Standard Ebooks states the same in its rights statement below.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published there, so the US rule settles the origin whatever the death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
